overview: 12-month, full-coverage backend-focused software engineer roadmap (5 hours/day). Starts with JavaScript fundamentals and builds through TypeScript, data structures & algorithms, Node.js/Express, databases, testing, deployment, security, performance and architecture. Includes 3 progressive projects (starter API, full-stack service, capstone microservices+AI), ongoing interview prep and soft-skill development. Monthly load ~150 hours (≈5h/day).

tips: Treat the plan as a living document: adjust weekly based on progress and energy.
Block a consistent daily time slot (5 hours) and protect it; prioritize deep work stretches.
Keep one ongoing project active throughout months (the capstone) and incrementally add features—projects cement learning.
Use the last day of each week for review: consolidate notes, update README/ADRs, and write 3 key takeaways.
Schedule weekly algorithm practice (3–4 focused problems) after month 4; increase intensity in last 3 months.
Automate small habits: CI run on every PR, daily journaling of what you learned, and a weekly demo to a peer or mentor.
Rest and recovery matter: take one full day off per week to avoid burnout and improve retention.
